name: Highland Malt 12 Year
description: A rich and warming single malt with notes of heather honey, dried fruit, and a whisper of coastal smoke. Long, satisfying finish.

name: London Dry Gin
description: A classic London Dry expression built on juniper, with bright citrus peel, coriander, and a dry, clean finish. Perfect in a G&T.

name: Dark Spiced Rum
description: Bold and full-bodied with molasses, vanilla bean, cinnamon, and a touch of dark chocolate. A smooth sipping rum.

name: Crystal Vodka
description: Triple-distilled from the finest winter wheat. Exceptionally clean and smooth with a subtle sweetness and silky texture.

name: Agave Tequila Reposado
description: Aged 8 months in American oak barrels. Cooked agave sweetness balanced with vanilla, light oak spice, and a warm earthy finish.

name: Violet Berry Liqueur
description: A luscious liqueur crafted from wild blackberries and violet blossoms. Deeply aromatic with a velvety, sweet finish.

name: Kentucky Straight Bourbon
description: Full-bodied and robust with caramel, toasted oak, vanilla, and a bold rye spice on the finish. A true American classic.

name: VSOP Cognac
description: An elegant VSOP aged a minimum of 4 years in Limousin oak. Dried apricot, orange zest, roasted nuts, and a long spiced finish.
